scientific_integrity: Moment and quartic identities proved symbolically; finite exact arithmetic checker is supplementary rather than proof of infinitely many parameter instances.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for degree-two analytic polynomial reproducing kernel on noncircular planar ellipse with probability power weight alpha>-1; distinct from full Bergman kernel, real multivariate polynomial Christoffel functions and arbitrary geometries. General ellipse orthogonal basis is credited to 2019 prior art. No higher-degree statement. Historical priority best-knowledge with risk of older equivalent moment argument.
title: A sharp two-site bifurcation of the quadratic analytic Christoffel kernel on weighted ellipses
